authors: A. V. Kotikov, L. N. Lipatov, A. Rej, M. Staudacher, V. N. Velizhanin
title: Dressing and wrapping
claim: The dressed asymptotic Bethe ansatz prediction for the four-loop twist-two anomalous dimension at finite spin violates BFKL constraints, so the ABA fails for length-two operators at four loops (wrapping); conjecture for an exact four-loop twist-two result.
scheme: No regularization: not a DR (or any Feynman-graph) computation. Planar spectrum obtained from the integrable AdS5 x S5 worldsheet S-matrix (asymptotic Bethe ansatz with BES/BHL dressing phase) plus finite-size corrections. BFKL (from high-energy amplitudes) used as an external field-theory constraint.
symmetry_argument: integrability + analytic continuation in spin + BFKL pole structure

proved: ABA (with BES dressing) is incompatible with BFKL for twist two at four loops
assumed: all-loop integrability of planar N=4 SYM / AdS5 x S5 superstring
asymptotic Bethe ansatz with the BES/BHL dressing phase (exact worldsheet S-matrix)
identification of gauge-theory anomalous dimensions with string energies (AdS/CFT) in the planar limit
validity of the BFKL constraint in N=4 at NLO (itself derived with DR-based computations)

red_flags: shows the asymptotic integrability framework is incomplete at four loops for short operators - a warning against using ABA alone for short operators
cross_checks: wrapping supplied by S1b.12; Konishi (spin 2) four-loop wrapping by S1a.02, S1a.06, S1b.01
